_meta.title: feat(parser): widen the token type to include comments
_meta.head: a1b2c3d4e5f6
_meta.note: This file ships with the dev build so the Scenario 5 demo lights up out of the box. In production CI, the workflow at .github/workflows/claude-review.yml overwrites this with the latest real run.

comments.rationale: The widened `TokenKind` should be exported as a const-assertion so consumers can derive a string-literal union via `typeof`. Today they re-declare the same set in `src/parser/lexer.ts:9`.
Doc comment refers to `TokenType` but the symbol was renamed to `TokenKind` in this PR. Quick rename to keep the docs in sync.
